title.narrative: Building Resilience to Recurring Food Insecurity Program

description.narrative: The objective of the project is to contribute to the reduction of food insecurity and to the development of the resilience of vulnerable populations in Senegal. More specifically, the project aims to: (i) improve the livelihoods of the targeted rural population by increasing the productive capacity of their assets; (ii) capacity building of target communities to adapt to climate change; (iii) and improving the capacity of decision-makers to manage food crises.
